# Datasite + GrowthBook
Date: 2026-10-26 | Duration: 52.59000015258789m

## Summary
Datasite evaluated GrowthBook as an experimentation platform to improve website conversion, demand, and revenue. The team prioritized a form-length test removing job-title and organization fields, while measuring form completion and downstream funnel progress. Other possible tests included layouts, content, images, video, media removal, and separate-page experiences. Datasite prefers managing content and variants through Sanity, and GrowthBook confirmed support for dynamic content, alternate pages, Snowflake warehouse integration, no-code metrics, audience targeting, funnel analysis, feature flags, and Bayesian or frequentist analysis. Personalization remains exploratory because Datasite has no defined strategy. GrowthBook quoted a $200,000 annual platform fee, plus user- or experiment-based pricing; Ted said this was far outside the expected range and that no experimentation platform budget had been allocated. GrowthBook will provide documentation, the recording, pricing options, Sanity details, and visual-editor guidance, while Datasite continues its evaluation.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, A/B testing, Sanity CMS, Personalisation, Snowflake analytics, Form conversion

## Action Items
**Sam Santos**
Verify Datasite monthly website traffic figure (15:13)

**Christian Liebenow**
Send Datasite GrowthBook demonstration recording (50:53)
Send Datasite GrowthBook documentation links (50:53)
Share potential pricing flexibility information (50:53)
